hours.reason: Classic Squamish summer thermal: valley heats, draws air up Howe Sound from the south. Multiple models agree, which is a good sign for a thermal-driven day. Solar loading is strong (~601 W/m²) — good thermal driver. Field-calibrated: raw coarse-model wind (~3kt) is scaled up ~2.85x, matching how this thermal typically under-reads on GFS-class models (source: local rider calibration, see README). MSLP backs this up — both the large-scale coast-vs-interior spread (1.9hPa) and the local channel spread (0.6hPa) favor inflow.
hours.summary: Afternoon sea-breeze pattern — builds through the day, fades around sunset.
